title: Primordial vortex and the deep-quantum limit
html:
As r\to 0, the spectral resolvents converge toward the primordial vortex:

  • The quantum Planck constant \hbar_q\to 1.
  • The q-torsion leaves collapse to the zero-dimensional stratum M_0=\{\pm 1\}.
  • The \omega_0 coordinate blows up in the jet prolongation, representing the concentration of energy at a singular spatial point.

Space-like energy becomes trapped because the time-like rotation achieves infinite frequency with zero displacement, effectively turning the \mathrm{SU}(2) holonomy into a localised topological charge.
